Topic 1.2: Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing
2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an
3. describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning
4. appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT DIVISION MEANS
Division shares a total into equal groups. 12 ÷ 3 = 4 means 12 split into 3 equal groups of 4.

WORKED EXAMPLES
A: 24 ÷ 6 = 4 because 6 × 4 = 24.
B: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 because 4 × 9 = 36.
C: 45 ÷ 5 = 9 because 5 × 9 = 45.

Check every division by multiplying back.
Real life: 30 exercise books shared equally among 5 learners → 30 ÷ 5 = 6 each.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: 24 ÷ 6 = 4 (check: 6 × 4 = 24).

Example 2: 36 ÷ 4 = 9 (check: 4 × 9 = 36).

Example 3: Share 30 books among 5 learners → 6 each.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Work out: 18 ÷ 3, 28 ÷ 7, 40 ÷ 8. Multiply back to check.
2. Word problem: 24 oranges shared equally among 6 children. How many each?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing
2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an
3. describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning
4. appreciate the division of the Qur’an for ease of recitation
